- Initial release of "continuous-test-review-loop" skill.
- Establishes a standardized process for continuous testing, review, improvement, and retesting, including fixed test lists, review templates, closed improvement loops, and reporting.
- Supports multilingual input/output (Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Arabic) with automatic language detection and response.
- Integrates SynomosAI governance standards: AI Passport Regime, A³ Laws, XCGS governance, and audit traceability.
- Provides clear trigger keywords and aliases for easy access.
